## D08 — Independent Adversarial Review / Round 1: FIX REQUIRED (CI visual reproducibility)

**PR:** #16 (DRAFT, still OPEN); **Issue:** #15 (OPEN); **head:** `8625597393d1d467b90ae83630fd280177d5b590`; base `main` at D07 merge `24d56a9af81d0277224dc0f3b7eff5fd0f395bf3`. One commit ahead, no missing base commits, 500 changed files mostly screenshot evidence.

### Independently verified PASS on actual Windows machine
- `scripts/check.ps1` EXIT **0**: **76/76 frontend** tests, **220/220 backend/API/Git guards**, ESLint, TypeScript strict, Ruff, production Vite build, secret/artifact scan **852 paths / 0 findings**, diff checks.
- Actual cached E5 CPU (HF/Transformers OFFLINE, cloud and Ollama disabled): **6/6 real-model integrations PASS, exit 0**. E5 384D, SQLite/ACTIVE, search/verified source, guided session, RAG search-only/mock and previous phase regressions.
- Actual Microsoft Edge **20/20 real-E5 E2E PASS, exit 0**; actual local backend/SQLite, not a mocked model.
- Independent Edge visual suite with `PVL_E2E_FIXTURE=1`, `PVL_VISUAL_STAGE=verify`, `PVL_VISUAL_REPLAY=1`: **7/7 PASS, exit 0**, 64 strict screenshot comparisons, deliberate-color negative oracle, lazy import/recovery, GSAP cleanup, keyboard/dialog, reduced motion, safe guide cancellation. Local working tree still clean after review.
- `npm audit --audit-level=moderate`: 0 vulnerabilities, exit 0. `pip check`: no broken requirements.
- Production JS entry **292.49 kB** and initial static JS **305.605 kB** vs D07 **660.065 kB**, a measured **53.70% reduction**; code splitting is real, warning threshold unchanged. Total JS modestly rises; the first Architecture navigation is slower (documented +223ms in 5 local samples), not concealed.
- Inspected actual BEFORE/AFTER Overview and after Documents mobile, E5 vector desktop, Search mobile, RAG mobile, Simulator mobile, Guided/citations. No verified D08 business logic regression or disappearance of source/score/NOT-E5/Mock Ollama/Slab SIMULATION distinctions. The 390px graph pans/zooms with a full text alternative.

### CI BLOCKER within the D08 Definition of Done — identical failure on **two separate attempts**
[Offline quality GitHub Actions run **43280051381**](https://github.com/iamqthanq/pinecone-visual-lab/actions/runs/43280051381) **FAIL on attempt 1 AND retry attempt 2**, at `Frozen visual candidate regression (recorded NOT E5, no API/cloud/model)`.
- Both attempts: GitHub Windows runner quality/build/security and fixture integration **20/20 PASS**. The visual suite then returns **6 PASS / 1 FAIL**, same state, same reported pixel count.
- Failure: `tests/visual/audit.spec.ts:78` during `architecture-write-1440.png`; `expect(page).toHaveScreenshot(...)` reports **101 differing pixels**, with `maxDiffPixels=100`, `threshold=0.1`. Candidate: `docs/evidence/d08/after/fixture/architecture-write-1440.png`. Playwright did wait for fonts and a stable screenshot.
- Independently downloaded actual/expected/diff and trace from first GitHub Actions artifact: https://github.com/iamqthanq/pinecone-visual-lab/actions/runs/43280051381/artifacts/13974080022 . The rendered page content/layout appears equivalent. Diff is dispersed around fine text/icon/graph edges, **consistent with** Windows/Edge raster or font rendering differences (not yet proven exact root cause). The same **101/100** failure on retry rules out treating the failure as a single unrepeatable timing incident.
- The local suite's 7/7 pass does **not** override a GitHub CI required gate. Live Pinecone and real Ollama remain **NOT VERIFIED**, correctly distinguished from local E5, fixture and mock.

### Required narrow follow-up — fix without weakening visual acceptance
1. On current **Issue #15** and current feature branch only, inspect the two CI attempt logs, captured expected/actual/diff/trace, and compare exact Windows runner/Edge build, locale/font raster, deviceScaleFactor, React Flow SVG/labels, layout settle and animation sources. Reproduce/diagnose the **same** 101-pixel discrepancy.
2. Make deterministic screenshot capture/comparison **reproducible on GitHub Windows runners**. Preserve the 64 substantive screenshot states and the deliberate-color mutation negative oracle. Retain the existing `maxDiffPixels=100` / `threshold=0.1` unless an independent evidence-backed change has been explicitly reviewed and accepted; **do not simply raise tolerances**, mask large portions of graph, skip CI/test, invoke `--update-snapshots`, silently replace baseline or accept arbitrary visual changes as PASS.
3. If a new Windows canonical reference is genuinely required, first produce a separate inspectable actual/expected/diff and explicit before/after justification; leave original evidence traceable. Do not claim an unreviewed updated golden is approved. Preserve readable source IDs, simulator labels, controls, accessibility/320px checks, GSAP lifecycle and deterministic snapshots.
4. After the minimal fix, rerun frontend/backend/Git, real cached E5, local Edge real E5 + CI NOT-E5 fixture 20/20, visual local and GitHub Actions. Provide exact new SHA, logs, visual diff evidence, check count/exit codes. Keep `docs/evidence/d08/REPORT.md` accurate and record this R1 CI reproducibility issue and its verified fix.
5. Safe commit/push **only** `feature/issue-15-taste-gsap-polish` using `scripts/push_issue_branch.ps1`, verify HEAD == origin and clean worktree. **Do not create another PR, merge, close #15, modify main, start D09 or install/pull AI models/cloud services.** Return `READY FOR CHATGPT INDEPENDENT RE-REVIEW`.

**VERDICT: FIX REQUIRED / NOT READY TO MERGE.** This is a required CI visual stability gate, **not an independently verified D08 production correctness BLOCKER**. All other independently checked gates PASS. Owner retains merge decision after successful re-review.
